tldr: Heavy news day. Microsoft's largest-ever Patch Tuesday shipped with an actively exploited Outlook zero-day, while CISA's KEV catalog grew with fresh Barracuda, Cisco, Openwave, IBM Aspera and SignalWire entries under active attack. A Qubole AWS supply-chain breach hit over a dozen companies, Turla stole NATO/EU diplomatic email, and France formally blamed Iran's IRGC for sabotaging supermarket refrigeration systems.

emerging.title: AI Inference Engine RCE Used to Breach NEAR AI, Steal Data From Live AI Agents
emerging.description: An attacker exploited an RCE flaw in the SGLang inference engine to reach inside a trusted execution environment at NEAR AI, stealing data from 18 running AI agents and ~100 users — among the first confirmed breaches targeting live AI agents directly.

emerging.title: Unpatched iOS Sandbox Escape Could Expose Crypto Wallet Seed Phrases
emerging.description: Binance warned of a publicly disclosed iOS 26/27 sandbox-escape flaw letting apps read other apps' private files, potentially leaking wallet seed phrases and credentials. No Apple fix confirmed yet; users told to remove sideloaded apps.

items.title: Microsoft's Record November Patch Tuesday Fixes Actively Exploited Outlook Zero-Day
items.description: Microsoft patched 1,235 vulnerabilities (63 critical), including CVE-2026-124194, an Outlook spoofing flaw already under active attack and added to CISA's KEV catalog. Patch immediately.

items.title: Chrome's Eighth Zero-Day of 2026 Patched After Active Exploitation
items.description: Google issued an emergency Chrome update for CVE-2026-125350, a use-after-free in the XML component exploited in the wild and reported anonymously on Nov 6. Update browsers now.

items.title: Barracuda ESG Flaws Actively Exploited for Root Access
items.description: Attackers are exploiting two recently patched Barracuda Email Security Gateway flaws (CVE-2026-116606, CVE-2026-111560) to run commands with root privileges; CISA added both to its KEV catalog Nov 10.

items.title: CISA Adds Actively Exploited Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave Flaws to KEV
items.description: CISA added CVE-2026-20320 (Cisco BroadWorks) and CVE-2026-111793 (Openwave Webtop Media Transcoder) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog Nov 10-11 despite patches being available.

items.title: Critical Xen Orchestra Auth Bypass Exploited to Hijack VM Servers
items.description: An authentication bypass in Xen Orchestra (VSA-2026-062) is being actively exploited to gain admin access and potentially run code across managed XCP-ng pools; no CVE assigned yet.

items.title: Qubole AWS Supply-Chain Attack Breaches a Dozen-Plus Organizations
items.description: Attackers abused Qubole's trusted cross-account AWS IAM access to steal customer secrets, keys, and files from multiple companies between mid-October and early November; Wiz and Sentra led the investigation.

items.title: Fireworks AI Breach Widens to Expose Model Weights and Customer Data
items.description: The AI infrastructure startup confirmed attackers who compromised a third-party cloud provider in October also accessed datasets, incomplete model weights, secrets, and Notion AI chat logs for some accounts.

items.title: Turla's New "Cereal" Malware Steals NATO and EU Correspondence
items.description: Russian state-backed Turla is using a new modular toolset to intercept email on government Exchange servers in Kazakhstan and Romania, harvesting NATO and EU diplomatic correspondence, per ESET.

items.title: France Blames Iran's IRGC for Refrigeration Sabotage at ~700 Retail Sites
items.description: France formally attributed October's attack that overheated supermarket refrigeration controllers to an IRGC cyber unit, summoning Iran's ambassador and opening a judicial probe; EU sanctions are expected to follow.

items.title: N-able Takes N-central Offline After Researcher Drops 33 Alleged Zero-Days
items.description: N-able pulled its hosted RMM platform offline and told on-prem customers to shut down servers after a researcher published dozens of unpatched flaws enabling RCE and admin-account creation; no confirmed exploitation yet.

action: Patch immediately: Microsoft Outlook (CVE-2026-124194), Chrome (CVE-2026-125350), Barracuda ESG (CVE-2026-116606/111560), Cisco BroadWorks (CVE-2026-20320), Openwave Webtop Media Transcoder (CVE-2026-111793), and Xen Orchestra (VSA-2026-062) — all under active exploitation. Audit any AWS IAM roles/keys granted to Qubole for signs of compromise. If running N-able N-central, follow vendor guidance to shut down on-prem servers pending a hotfix. iOS users should remove untrusted sideloaded apps pending Apple's fix for the Binance-flagged sandbox-escape flaw.
